lines.en: label makispring2:
scene makikyoto1
{i}Hello alone.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你好，孤独。{/i}

lines.en: scene makikyoto2
So I’m here again, hello — on the way to wherever Maki wants to take me to try and fix me.
lines.zh: 于是我又来了，你好——正走在路上，去往 Maki 想带我去、好把我修好的那个地方。

lines.en: And while I’m ever-depressed by the notion that my misery is so apparent to everyone at this point, I take solace in the fact that this flaw has once again rescued me from harm’s way.
lines.zh: 虽然「我的痛苦到这个地步已经人尽皆知」这件事让我愈发消沉，但我也从这点上得到些许安慰：这个缺陷又一次把我从险境里救了出来。

lines.en: How lucky I am to have so many attentive friends. How lucky I am to be pulled away from my inner struggles constantly whenever they’re around.
lines.zh: 我多幸运，能有这么多体贴的朋友。我多幸运，只要他们在身边，就能不断被从内心的挣扎里拽出来。

lines.en: It’s almost as if the world is telling me I’m not {i}meant{/i} to be alone. Or that I should lean on others for help more. Or whatever else I know to be true but neglect to believe regardless.
lines.zh: 就好像世界在告诉我，我{i}不该{/i}独处。或者告诉我，我该多依靠别人一些。或者其他那些我明知为真、却始终不肯相信的道理。

lines.en: She won’t force me to talk. She’ll merely give me the opportunity to. And should I neglect {i}that{/i} as well, I imagine she’ll be perfectly content with just being in the same place as me.
lines.zh: 她不会逼我开口。她只会给我开口的机会。而如果我连{i}这个机会{/i}也放过，我想她也完全满足于只是和我待在同一个地方。

lines.en: Maybe she {i}does{/i} just want to drive? That’s what I’ll tell myself until we get to wherever we’re going.
lines.zh: 也许她{i}真的{/i}只是想开车？在到达目的地之前，我就这么告诉自己吧。

lines.en: But when these shaking hands reach for the handle once this car comes to a stop, I pray that I won’t recall the days when they were smaller and steadier.
lines.zh: 但这辆车停稳、我这双颤抖的手伸向车门把手的时候，我只祈求自己不会想起它们还更小、也更稳的那些日子。

lines.en: Someone else sat beside me back then.
lines.zh: 那时候，坐在我旁边的是另一个人。

lines.en: Someone who I never thought I’d be able to live without.
lines.zh: 一个我从不认为自己失去她还能活下去的人。

lines.en: How apt that I’ve spent nearly a decade since then coming to terms with (or avoiding) just how true that is.
lines.zh: 多贴切啊——从那以后的近十年里，我一直在接受（或者说回避）这件事到底有多真实。

lines.en: : Have you ever driven a car, Akira?
lines.zh: : 你开过车吗，Akira？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene makikyoto3
: Have you or have you {i}not{/i} ever driven a motor vehicle? It’s a simple question.
lines.zh: : 你到底开{i}没{/i}开过机动车？很简单的问题。

lines.en: : Oh, you’re not taking me somewhere I can “practice,” are you? You know I have a thing with cars.
lines.zh: : 你该不会是要带我去个能「练车」的地方吧？你知道我跟车犯冲的。

lines.en: : I’m not taking you anywhere in particular. I’m just driving.
lines.zh: : 我没要带你去什么特别的地方。我就是开车。

lines.en: scene makikyoto4
: We’re lucky to live somewhere we don’t really {i}need{/i} to know how to drive. So it’s not every day you get to spend time without someone who has.
lines.zh: : 我们能住在这样一个不太{i}需要{/i}会开车的地方，真是幸运。所以能和一个不开车的人待在一起，可不是天天都有的。

lines.en: : It’s pretty liberating, actually. Terrifying, at first...but really freeing once the jitters wear off.
lines.zh: : 其实挺让人自由的。一开始挺吓人的……但等那股紧张劲儿过去，就真的很自在了。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: There are a lot of things in life like that, aren’t there?
lines.zh: : 生活里有很多事都是这样，对吧？

lines.en: scene makikyoto5
: Yeah...
: There sure are.
lines.zh: : 确实不少。

lines.en: : You know...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……

lines.en: : I’d never think less of someone for learning early. I’d think less of the person who taught them.
lines.zh: : 我绝不会因为一个人学得早而看轻他。我会看轻的，是教他的那个人。

lines.en: : Like Makoto, for example. I don’t think she’s ready yet, but I’ve told her about it and think she could figure it out pretty easily if she wanted to. Miku, though? I wouldn’t trust her behind the wheel of a car at all.
lines.zh: : 拿 Makoto 来说吧。我觉得她还没准备好，但我跟她讲过，觉得她要是想学，肯定很快就能上手。至于 Miku 嘛？我可完全不敢让她碰方向盘。

lines.en: : The unfortunate truth, though, is that I wouldn’t be able to stop them if they really wanted to.
lines.zh: : 但无奈的事实是，要是她们真想做，我也拦不住。

lines.en: : That said, I’m not going to just hop in the passenger seat and watch as they figure it out on their own. Doing that would be directly putting them in harm’s way. Don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 话虽如此，我也不会就这么坐进副驾、眼睁睁看她们自己摸索。那样做等于直接把她们往危险里推。你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : Maki-
lines.zh: : Maki——

lines.en: : It’s just driving, Akira.
lines.zh: : 只是开车而已，Akira。

lines.en: : We’re talking about driving.
lines.zh: : 我们聊的是开车。

lines.en: : I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 对不起。

lines.en: : I thought that would make it easier.
lines.zh: : 我以为那样说会好受些。

lines.en: : There’s nothing to be sorry for.
lines.zh: : 没什么好对不起的。

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : Have a thing with cars.
lines.zh: : 跟车犯冲。

lines.en: scene makikyoto6
: Yeah...
: Why don’t we pull over then? This looks like a nice spot to get out and relax for a little while.
lines.zh: : 那我们靠边停一下？这地方看着不错，可以下车放松一会儿。

lines.en: scene black
: Yeah...whatever you want.
lines.zh: : 嗯……随你。

lines.en: Maki pulls off to the side of the road and parks her car in a spot with faded lines and cracked paint — causing memories to roll in before my shaking hands have the chance to evoke them.
lines.zh: Maki 把车开到路边停下，停进划线已经褪色、漆面开裂的车位里——不等我那双颤抖的手去唤起什么，回忆就先涌了进来。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
There was a spot that {i}she{/i} used to park her car in after picking me up from Niki’s place.
lines.zh: 曾经有那么一个车位，{i}她{/i}从 Niki 家接上我之后，总把车停在那里。

lines.en: Halfway between my childhood home and the one {i}she{/i} made with {i}him,{/i} there was an old shopping plaza she told me she worked at when she was younger.
lines.zh: 在我童年时的家、和{i}她{/i}与{i}他{/i}组建的那个家中间，有一座老旧的购物广场，她说她年轻时在那儿上过班。

lines.en: I never believed her, though. The thought of her having any sort of regular job just seemed flat out bizarre to me. She was larger than life. She was {i}Sekai.{/i}
lines.zh: 不过我从来没信过她。光是想象她有一份正经工作，我就觉得荒唐至极。她比生活本身更大。她是 {i}Sekai{/i}。

lines.en: Something didn’t {i}always{/i} happen when she pulled into that spot in the back of the shopping plaza...But many days, something did.
lines.zh: 她把车倒进购物广场后面那个车位时，并不是{i}每次{/i}都会发生点什么……但有很多天，确实发生了。

lines.en: Something that, like driving, felt liberating. Terrifying at first...but freeing once the jitters wore off.
lines.zh: 一些和开车一样让人觉得自由的事。一开始很可怕……但等那股紧张劲儿过去，就很自在。

lines.en: She taught me everything I know.
lines.zh: 我所知道的一切，都是她教的。

lines.en: Now, every single vehicle I lay my eyes on reminds me of her.
lines.zh: 如今，我目光所及的每一辆车，都让我想起她。

lines.en: scene makikyoto7
Some days, when I stare up at that wall, I imagine what {i}she{/i} would have done about it. Because if anyone could figure out how to scale it, it would have been her.
lines.zh: 有些日子，我抬头盯着那道墙，会想象{i}她{/i}会拿它怎么办。因为如果有人能想出翻过去的办法，那一定是她。

lines.en: She didn’t even like sitting in that car for more than an hour at a time. She always needed to be moving. There’s no {i}way{/i} she’d just sit back and let some colossal barrier keep her from getting out of here.
lines.zh: 她连在车里连续坐一个小时都不愿意。她总得动着。她{i}绝不可能{/i}就这么坐视不管，让一道巨大的屏障把她困在这里。

lines.en: Guess she figured it out in the end, though. Now, even death can’t keep her in one place.
lines.zh: 不过看来她最后还是想出办法了。现在，连死亡都留不住她待在一个地方。

lines.en: : It’s always crazy when I remember how we used to be able to just...leave. The thought of that today is just...surreal.
lines.zh: : 每次想起我们以前可以就这么……离开，都觉得疯了。现在再想这件事，简直……超现实。

lines.en: : Have you ever been outside of Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : 你出过 Kumon-mi 吗？

lines.en: : Kyoto for a field trip once.
lines.zh: : 修学旅行去过一次京都。

lines.en: : Ahh...
: Never been.
lines.zh: : 我从没出去过。

lines.en: : It’s beautiful. Romantic. You’d love it there.
lines.zh: : 那儿很美。很浪漫。你一定会喜欢的。

lines.en: : Yeah...I probably would.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我大概会吧。

lines.en: : Have you ever been {i}anywhere{/i} outside of Kumon-mi? Tokyo, maybe?
lines.zh: : 你去过 Kumon-mi 以外的{i}地方{/i}吗？比如东京？

lines.en: : If I have, I can’t remember it.
lines.zh: : 就算去过，我也不记得了。

lines.en: : At the very least, I know Ami’s never left. No real desire to either.
lines.zh: : 至少我知道 Ami 从没离开过。她也没什么想走的念头。

lines.en: : Yeah. Plenty of people seem perfectly content with just...never getting out and exploring.
lines.zh: : 嗯。好多人似乎就这么……从不出去看看，也过得挺满足。

lines.en: : That was weird to me when I was younger, but I’m starting to understand it now.
lines.zh: : 我年轻时觉得这很奇怪，不过现在开始理解了。

lines.en: : The longer we stay behind this thing, the more comfortable we become with everything that’s inside of it. But of course that makes everything on the {i}outside{/i} scarier.
lines.zh: : 我们在这东西后面待得越久，就越习惯里面的一切。但理所当然，这也让{i}外面{/i}的一切变得更可怕。

lines.en: : Like, for all {i}we{/i} know, everything else could be gone already.
lines.zh: : 比如说，说不定外面的一切早就没了，{i}我们{/i}也不知道。

lines.en: : We still get TV and stuff from the outside, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我们还是能收到外面的电视什么的。

lines.en: : Sure, but is anything actually {i}real{/i} before we see it with our own eyes?
lines.zh: : 是没错，可在我们亲眼看到之前，有什么是{i}真的{/i}呢？

lines.en: : Yes. Otherwise those things would not exist for us to see. But I get what you’re saying.
lines.zh: : 是真的。不然那些东西就不会存在、等着我们去看。不过我懂你的意思。

lines.en: : Yeah. Exactly. You’re the smart one here. I make a living selling rubber penises.
lines.zh: : 嗯。就是这个意思。这儿聪明的是你。我不过是靠卖橡胶阴茎谋生。

lines.en: : You’re smart too, Maki. Your knowledge is just a little less...conventional than it is for most people.
lines.zh: : 你也很聪明，Maki。只是你的知识比大多数人的……不那么常规一点。

lines.en: : Thanks, Akira. That means a lot coming from someone who’s never bought any of my rubber penises.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Akira。从一个一根我的橡胶阴茎都没买过的人口里说出来，这话分量可不轻。

lines.en: : I will eventually. I still owe several people secret Santa presents, I think. Maybe I’ll just wait a few more years and place a bulk order?
lines.zh: : 我总会买的。我好像还欠好几个人秘密圣诞老人的礼物。要不我再等几年，直接下一笔大单？

lines.en: : Well, you best hurry up or Miku’s Cock Emporium is going to put my place out of business.
lines.zh: : 那你最好快点，不然 Miku 鸡巴大卖场就要把我这儿挤垮了。

lines.en: : Only a matter of time.
lines.zh: : 只是时间问题。

lines.en: : Only a matter of time...
lines.zh: : 只是时间问题……

lines.en: scene makikyoto8
: I wonder if anybody’s ever had sex up against the barrier?
lines.zh: : 我在想，会不会有人贴着那道屏障做过爱？

lines.en: : Maki.
lines.zh: : Maki。

lines.en: scene makikyoto9
: What?! That’s a totally normal thing to wonder! Somebody’s had to have done it by now, right?
lines.zh: : 什么？！这想法很正常啊！到现在肯定有人干过了吧？

lines.en: : It...does seem statistically improbable that everyone in this city would have avoided it, yes.
lines.zh: : 从统计上看，这座城市里所有人都不约而同地避开它……确实不太可能，没错。

lines.en: scene makikyoto10
: I wonder what the first couple thought? Assuming it was a regular couple and not an orgy, of course. But hey, that sex club downtown organizes some crazy events sometimes. Maybe {i}they{/i} did it?
lines.zh: : 我在想第一对儿是怎么想的？当然，得假设那是一对普通情侣、不是群交。不过话说回来，市中心那家性爱俱乐部偶尔会搞些疯狂的活动。说不定是{i}他们{/i}干的？

lines.en: : I’m sure learning a lot about a sex club I didn’t know existed until today...today.
lines.zh: : 我今天……今天可真是收获了不少关于一家我今天才知道存在的性爱俱乐部的知识。

lines.en: if makisex == True:
: Maybe we can go together? You’ll get in for free if I bring you along.
lines.zh: : 要不我们一起去？我带你进去的话，你免门票。

lines.en: : Only if you promise to stay mine while we’re in there and not run off with some other guy.
lines.zh: : 只要你保证在里面的时候一直是我的人，不跟别的男人跑了。

lines.en: scene makikyoto11
: Deal.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: : How about you, though? You’ll be immensely outnumbered. Think I’ll be enough for you in there?
lines.zh: : 那你呢？你的人数劣势可太大了。你觉得我在那儿够你用的吗？

lines.en: : I think...I’m not sure if you {i}want{/i} to be enough for me in there.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……我不确定你会不会{i}想{/i}在那种地方「够我用」。

lines.en: : Monogamy can be fun too, Akira.
lines.zh: : 一对一也可以很有意思的，Akira。

lines.en: scene makikyoto12
: Though...I guess it {i}might{/i} be a little weird if we just go there and only screw each other. Nobody else there really rolls like that.
lines.zh: : 不过……我想如果我们去了那儿，却只跟对方做，{i}可能{/i}有点怪。那儿没人是这么玩的。

lines.en: else:
: Great news for me. Less competition when it comes to buying their old stuff.
lines.zh: : 对我来说是好消息。这样买他们旧货的时候竞争就少了。

lines.en: : You should check it out, though. You’d like it there. {i}Plus,{/i} you’d be greatly outnumbered. Just one more benefit of not getting called to war and killed by aliens.
lines.zh: : 不过你该去看看。你会喜欢的。{i}再说了，{/i}你的人数优势会非常大。这又是「没被征召去打仗、也没被外星人弄死」的又一个好处。

lines.en: : Maybe the alien sex was worth it?
lines.zh: : 说不定跟外星人做爱也值了？

lines.en: : Asking myself that question is exactly what I do to calm down when I think about Masahiro. He always {i}said{/i} he wanted to fuck an alien.
lines.zh: : 每当我想起 Masahiro，我就是这样问自己来让自己平静下来的。他{i}总说{/i}想跟外星人上床。

lines.en: scene makikyoto13
: Regardless, it’s cool knowing that, in this world of infinite possibilities, there are new “firsts” every single day.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，知道在这个充满无限可能的世界里、每天都有新的「第一次」，还挺酷的。

lines.en: : First people to bone up against the barrier...first people to {i}talk{/i} about the first people to bone up against the barrier...and the first people to mention people talking about the first people to-
lines.zh: : 第一个贴着屏障干的人……第一个{i}谈论{/i}第一个贴着屏障干的人的人……还有第一个提到有人在谈论第一个——

lines.en: : I get it, Maki.
lines.zh: : 我懂了，Maki。

lines.en: : Good, because I was starting to lose track of what I was saying.
lines.zh: : 那就好，因为我刚开始要忘了自己在说什么了。

lines.en: scene makikyoto14
: But I guess if we’re all out of topics, we-
lines.zh: : 不过我猜，要是话题都聊完了，我们就——

lines.en: scene makikyoto15
: ...Akira?
lines.zh: : ……Akira？

lines.en: scene black
scene makikyoto16
: Was...it something I said? Do you...need something? What do I-
lines.zh: : 是……我说错什么了吗？你……需要什么吗？我该怎么——

lines.en: : I should have gone...
lines.zh: : 我本来该离开的……

lines.en: : Gone...where?
lines.zh: : 离开……去哪儿？

lines.en: : It doesn’t matter anymore...
lines.zh: : 现在已经无所谓了……

lines.en: : None of us are ever leaving this place again.
lines.zh: : 我们再也不可能离开这个地方了。

lines.en: : D...Do I...hug you? Do I give you space? What do I do? I’m bad at this. You need to tell me or I’ll get it wrong.
lines.zh: : 我……我是该……抱你吗？还是该给你点空间？我该怎么办？我不擅长这个。你得告诉我，不然我肯定会做错。

lines.en: scene makikyoto17
: Gah! My poor ghost legs! I’m never running that far again...{i}especially{/i} in that white dress. It was so tight that I had no choice but to stop for a change of clothes on the way here.
lines.zh: : 啊啊！我这双可怜的鬼腿！我再也不跑那么远了……{i}尤其是{/i}穿着那条白裙子。它紧得我半路上不得不停下来换了身衣服才过来。

lines.en: scene makikyoto18
: So! What’d I miss? Anything fun? Anything {i}sexy?{/i} What are you guys talking about?
lines.zh: : 好啦！我错过什么了？有什么好玩的吗？有什么{i}色色的{/i}吗？你俩在聊什么？

lines.en: : Nothing...
lines.zh: : 没什么……

lines.en: : Do...nothing? Okay. Got it. Carry on.
lines.zh: : 在……没什么？好吧。明白了。继续。

lines.en: : No...not you, Maki.
lines.zh: : 不……不是说你，Maki。

lines.en: : But...we’re the only ones here?
lines.zh: : 可是……这儿只有我们两个啊？

lines.en: : Not to me, we’re not.
lines.zh: : 对我来说，不是。

lines.en: scene makikyoto19
: I...don’t think I...understand...
lines.zh: : 我……我想我……不明白……

lines.en: : Driving...
lines.zh: : 开车的事……

lines.en: : I’m talking about driving.
lines.zh: : 我聊的是开车。

lines.en: scene makikyoto20
: Okay...sure.
lines.zh: : 好……好吧。

lines.en: : Was young.
lines.zh: : 那时还小。

lines.en: : Very young...
lines.zh: : 非常小……

lines.en: scene makikyoto21
: But I loved that person...with every fiber of my being. And when she...
lines.zh: : 可我爱那个人……用我身上的每一根纤维去爱。而当她……

lines.en: : When she died, it changed everything.
lines.zh: : 当她死的时候，一切都变了。

lines.en: : I still see her, Maki.
lines.zh: : 我到现在还看得见她，Maki。

lines.en: : She follows me. She speaks to me. She-
lines.zh: : 她跟着我。她跟我说话。她——

lines.en: : And she’s here right now?
lines.zh: : 那她现在就在这儿？

lines.en: : Present!
: Yeah...
: Can she hear me?
lines.zh: : 她能听见我说话吗？

lines.en: : Loud and clear!
lines.zh: : 听得清清楚楚！

lines.en: : Yes...
lines.zh: : 是的……

lines.en: : Great. Then can I have a minute to think of something really horrible to say to whoever did this to you?
lines.zh: : 很好。那能不能给我一分钟，让我想句特别难听的话，说给那个对你做出这种事的人听？

lines.en: scene makikyoto22
: One more girl who just doesn’t {i}get{/i} it. We really are a rare breed nowadays.
lines.zh: : 又一个{i}不明白{/i}的姑娘。我们这种人现在可真是稀有品种了。

lines.en: : It wasn’t her fault. She really {i}did{/i} love me. She just didn’t...see the world the way other people do.
lines.zh: : 那不是她的错。她是{i}真的{/i}爱我。她只是……看待世界的方式和别人不一样。

lines.en: : Akira-
lines.zh: : Akira——

lines.en: scene makikyoto23
: I get it. I blame her too sometimes. But then I...
lines.zh: : 我懂。有时候我也怪她。但随后我……

lines.en: : I remember all the {i}good{/i} things. How she saved me. How she gave me {i}something{/i} I could finally look forward to in a world where I...never had anything like that.
lines.zh: : 我就想起那些{i}好的{/i}部分。她怎么救了我。她怎么给了我{i}一样东西{/i}，让我终于可以在一个我……从来不曾拥有过那样东西的世界里有所期待。

lines.en: scene makikyoto24
: So yeah...I gave her all of me. Or whatever I had left, I guess. And I don’t regret it at all, but...I’m a monster now.
lines.zh: : 所以啊……我把全部的自己都给了她。或者说，把我剩下的那点东西都给了她。而我一点都不后悔，但……我现在是个怪物了。

lines.en: : And I spend a lot of time just wishing I was someone else...or {i}somewhere{/i} else.
lines.zh: : 而且我花了大把时间，只是希望自己是另一个人……或者在{i}另一个地方{/i}。

lines.en: : Anywhere but here would be fine.
lines.zh: : 除了这里，哪里都行。

lines.en: : Anyone but {i}me{/i} would be fine...
lines.zh: : 除了{i}我{/i}自己，是谁都行……

lines.en: scene makikyoto25
: Your past doesn’t make you a monster, Akira.
lines.zh: : 你的过去不会让你变成怪物，Akira。

lines.en: : No, it doesn’t. But she painted everything black and it’s hard to just...paint over that because it feels like I’d be erasing her.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不会。但她把一切都涂成了黑色，而我很难就这么……在上面重新刷一遍颜色，因为那感觉像是在抹掉她。

lines.en: : And if I let go of the parts of myself that {i}she{/i} put there...what if I never {i}saw{/i} her again? Because I want to let go! I do...
lines.zh: : 而如果我放掉{i}她{/i}留在我身上的那部分……万一我再也{i}见不到{/i}她了呢？因为我想放手的！我真的想……

lines.en: : But I also don’t want her to stay gone forever. {i}Because{/i} of those good parts. {i}Because{/i} I loved her.
lines.zh: : 可我也不想让她永远消失。{i}因为{/i}那些好的部分。{i}因为{/i}我爱过她。

lines.en: : That wasn’t {i}love,{/i} Akira...That was-
lines.zh: : 那不是{i}爱，{/i}Akira……那是——

lines.en: scene makikyoto26
: No! You don’t get it! It {i}was!{/i} And I know how it sounds, but it wasn’t like that! She was amazing! She wasn’t like {i}me!{/i} {i}I’m{/i} the one who’s terrible! She was just misunderstood!
lines.zh: : 不！你不懂！那{i}就是{/i}爱！我知道听起来像什么，但事情不是那样的！她很了不起！她跟{i}我{/i}不一样！糟糕的人是{i}我{/i}！她只是不被理解！

lines.en: : Aki-kun, don’t yell. She’s not going to get it. She’s not like us. Just let her say whatever she wants to say about me and call it a day. I can assure you I’ve heard worse.
lines.zh: : Aki 君，别吼。她不会懂的。她跟我们不一样。就让她随便怎么说我，然后收工吧。我向你保证，比这更难听的我听过。

lines.en: : You’re not like that deplorable woman, Akira! I know you! You’re better than-
lines.zh: : 你不是那种可鄙的女人，Akira！我了解你！你比——

lines.en: : You know what I {i}want{/i} you to know! But what if there’s more to me than that?! What if I’ve been hiding something?! Then what?!
lines.zh: : 你只知道我{i}想{/i}让你知道的那部分！可要是我还有别的呢？！要是我一直藏着什么呢？！那又怎样？！

lines.en: : Aki-kun, don’t do it. Don’t tell her you’ve-
lines.zh: : Aki 君，别这样。别告诉她你——

lines.en: scene makikyoto27
: Fucked your daughter like a gazillion times! {i}Both{/i} daughters, actually! And guess what, lady?! All that time teaching them about safe sex was for nothing! My Aki-kun likes it {i}raw!{/i}
lines.zh: : 把你女儿操了不知道多少次！{i}两个{/i}女儿，实话告诉你！猜怎么着，大姐？！你花那么多时间教她们安全性交全白费了！我们家 Aki 君就喜欢{i}无套的{/i}！

lines.en: scene makikyoto28
: Wha- get out of here, me! Aki-kun doesn’t want you here right now!
lines.zh: : 什么——给我滚，另一个我！Aki 君现在不想看到你！

lines.en: : Aki-kun doesn’t {i}know{/i} what he wants! That’s why I’m here in the first place!
lines.zh: : Aki 君根本不{i}知道{/i}自己想要什么！这才是我一开始会在这儿的原因！

lines.en: scene makikyoto29
: Aki-kun, look at me. You’re better than this. Don’t throw this away just because you’re getting emotional. It’s not worth it.
lines.zh: : Aki 君，看着我。你不该是这样的。别因为情绪上头就把这一切都扔了。不值得。

lines.en: scene makikyoto30
: No, Aki-kun! Look at me! You’re {i}not{/i} better than this. But that’s {i}okay!{/i} We know who we are and hiding it won’t do anything but confuse us! Accept it and just {i}live!{/i}
lines.zh: : 不，Aki 君！看着我！你并{i}没有{/i}比这更好。但那{i}没关系{/i}！我们知道自己是什么人，藏着掖着除了让我们更混乱，什么用也没有！认了，然后{i}活下去{/i}！

lines.en: : Akira-
lines.zh: : Akira——

lines.en: scene makikyoto31
: I don’t know what to do. I don’t know what to do. I don’t know what to-
lines.zh: : 我不知道该怎么办。我不知道该怎么办。我不知道该怎么——

lines.en: : {b}AKIRA!!!!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}AKIRA！！！！{/b}

lines.en: scene makikyoto32
scene makikyoto33
: Whatever you are...whatever you’ve {i}done...{/i}it’s okay...
lines.zh: : 不管你是什么……不管你{i}做过什么……{/i}都没关系……

lines.en: : We all make mistakes. But that doesn’t mean we can’t be forgiven.
lines.zh: : 我们都会犯错。但这不意味着我们就不能被原谅。

lines.en: : Can {i}everything{/i} be forgiven, Maki?...You don’t know what I’ve done.
lines.zh: : {i}什么都{/i}能被原谅吗，Maki？……你不知道我做过什么。

lines.en: : That doesn’t matter. What matters is that you {i}understand{/i} that what you’ve done is wrong and that you’re making an effort to get better.
lines.zh: : 那不重要。重要的是你{i}明白{/i}自己做错了，而且你在努力变好。

lines.en: : Hating you for being a shitty driver when you were taught by a shitty teacher isn’t going to do any good for anyone.
lines.zh: : 你被一个糟糕的老师教成了一个糟糕的司机，为此恨你对谁都没好处。

lines.en: : What if I’m not trying to get better, though?...What if I’m barreling down some suburban street at twice the recommended speed with my eyes closed and my hands off the wheel?
lines.zh: : 可要是我根本没在努力变好呢？……要是我正闭着眼睛、双手离开方向盘，以建议时速的两倍在郊区的街道上横冲直撞呢？

lines.en: : Then yeah, you’re a shitty person. But a shitty person wouldn’t be this-
lines.zh: : 那好吧，你确实是个烂人。但一个烂人不会这么——

lines.en: : Broken?...
: Is that what you want to say?...
lines.zh: : 你想说的是这个吧？……

lines.en: scene makikyoto34
: That changes nothing, Maki.
lines.zh: : 这改变不了什么，Maki。

lines.en: : I make my own decisions.
lines.zh: : 我自己的决定是我自己做的。

lines.en: : Are you sure about that? Because I’m not sure I believe it if you’re hallucinating a dead woman, Akira.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？因为如果你正在幻视一个死掉的女人，我可不确定我会信，Akira。

lines.en: : It gets...complicated when you...start bringing that kind of stuff into the picture. There’s all sorts of weird supernatural shit happening here every single day.
lines.zh: : 一旦你……把那种东西算进来，事情就……复杂了。这地方每天都在发生各种各样诡异的超自然破事。

lines.en: : That sounds exactly like what someone who’s losing it would say.
lines.zh: : 这话听起来正是一个正在崩溃的人会说的话。

lines.en: : Maki-
lines.zh: : Maki——

lines.en: scene makikyoto35
: Makoto was the same way when Masahiro died. And I know you lost someone else not too long ago, so maybe you just need a reset?
lines.zh: : Masahiro 走的时候，Makoto 也是这样。而且我知道你不久前也失去了另一个人，所以也许你只是需要重置一下？

lines.en: : Heh...yeah. Because those fix everything.
lines.zh: : 呵……是啊。因为重置能解决一切嘛。

lines.en: : A little break won’t hurt you, will it?
lines.zh: : 稍微歇一歇又不会伤着你，对吧？

lines.en: : Maki, why do you think I haven’t gone back to school yet? Why do you think I spend my days just wandering around Kumon-mi looking for shit to do or people to kill time with?
lines.zh: : Maki，你觉得我为什么还没回学校？你觉得我为什么整天就在 Kumon-mi 里瞎逛，找点事做、或者找个人一起消磨时间？

lines.en: : Because...
lines.zh: : 因为……

lines.en: scene makikyoto36
: Because you’re lost...
lines.zh: : 因为你迷路了……

lines.en: : Bingo.
lines.zh: : 答对了。

lines.en: : How are we supposed to find where you’re meant to be then?
lines.zh: : 那我们要怎么找到你该去的地方？

lines.en: : {i}You’re{/i} not supposed to do anything. I’m an adult. I’m supposed to figure that out alone. Like you did with Makoto.
lines.zh: : {i}你们{/i}什么都不用做。我是个成年人。这本该是我自己想明白的事。就像你对 Makoto 那样。

lines.en: : You {i}helped{/i} me with Makoto. I owe it to you to at least try and do the same.
lines.zh: : 你{i}帮过{/i}我 Makoto 的忙。我欠你的，至少该试着为你做同样的事。

lines.en: : Well...good luck. You’ve got your work cut out for you. Prepare to be let down more than you could ever believe.
lines.zh: : 嗯……祝你好运。你的活儿可不好干。做好心理准备，你会失望到难以置信。

lines.en: : At the very least...
lines.zh: : 至少……

lines.en: scene makikyoto37
: Thank you for telling me, Akira.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你告诉我，Akira。

lines.en: : Anything to lessen a burden placed entirely on you.
lines.zh: : 只要能减轻一点全压在你身上的重担，什么都行。

lines.en: : This lessens nothing...just makes me more self-conscious around you.
lines.zh: : 这什么也没减轻……只是让我在你面前更不自在了。

lines.en: : I’m sorry you feel that way, but I don’t. And if you ever need anything-
lines.zh: : 很抱歉你这么想，但我没有。而且如果你需要什么——

lines.en: : Can I get a ride home? I want to see Ami.
lines.zh: : 能载我回家吗？我想见 Ami。

lines.en: scene black
: ...Yeah.
: And I want to see Makoto.
lines.zh: : 我也想见 Makoto。

lines.en: My hands are surprisingly still when I get back into Maki’s car, but I don’t understand why.
lines.zh: 重新坐进 Maki 的车里时，我的手意外地稳，但我不明白为什么。

lines.en: I feel no better than I did before. My chest is no lighter now that one more secret has been shed from it into the palms of someone else who cares for no good reason at all.
lines.zh: 我并不比之前好受。又一个秘密从我胸口卸下、落进另一个毫无理由地关心着我的人掌心里，可我的胸口并没有变轻。

lines.en: Despite this, though...and despite the many hints of my deranged depravity that I forced upon Maki just minutes ago...she never stops checking on me the whole way home.
lines.zh: 尽管如此……尽管就在几分钟前，我把我那疯狂堕落的诸多端倪硬塞给了 Maki……回家的这一路上，她还是不停地留意着我。

lines.en: I don’t understand why.
lines.zh: 我不明白为什么。

lines.en: Is this willful ignorance?
lines.zh: 这是故意的无知吗？

lines.en: Is it pity?
lines.zh: 是怜悯吗？

lines.en: Or have I effortlessly warped {i}her{/i} definition of “love” now too?
lines.zh: 还是说，我又轻而易举地把{i}她{/i}对「爱」的定义也给扭曲了？

lines.en: Whatever the case, there’s one thing I know for sure.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，有一件事我很确定。

lines.en: It’s that I fucking hate driving.
lines.zh: 那就是我他妈恨死开车了。

$ maki_love += 1

lines.zh: {i}Maki 的好感度提升到了 [maki_love]!{/i}

lines.en: {i}You can’t hide the truth from her much longer.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你没法再对她隐瞒真相多久了。{/i}
